property.summary: A cliff-top villa with an infinity pool, three ensuite bedrooms and sunsets over the Indian Ocean.
property.description:
Perched on the limestone cliffs of Uluwatu, this calm, open-plan villa is built around a 12-metre infinity pool that seems to pour straight into the Indian Ocean.

Three air-conditioned bedrooms open onto the garden, each with its own bathroom. The living pavilion has a fully equipped kitchen, a long teak dining table and a sunken lounge facing west, so every evening ends with a sunset.

Our housekeeper comes in every morning, and we are happy to arrange a private chef, massages at the villa or a driver for the day.
property.additional_rules:
Quiet hours are from 10 pm to 7 am.
Please use the pool towels by the pool and keep the bath towels inside.
No glass in or around the pool.
property.space:
The villa is laid out as three pavilions around the pool. The main pavilion holds the living room, dining area and kitchen, with sliding walls that disappear completely in good weather.

The main bedroom has a king bed, a sunken bathtub and its own terrace. The two garden bedrooms share a covered walkway and each has a bathroom with a rain shower.
property.neighborhood: Uluwatu sits on the southern tip of the Bukit peninsula, known for its surf breaks, white-sand coves and an 11th-century sea temple. Bingin and Padang Padang beaches are a short drive away.
property.getting_around: A scooter or a car with driver is the easiest way around. We can book a driver for you; the airport is about 40 minutes away.
property.cancellation_policy: 100% refund 24 hours after booking accepted, if booking is requested at least 24 hours before check-in
property.payment_terms:
20% due at booking
30% due 45 days before check-in
50% due 10 days before check-in

items.title: Uluwatu Temple
items.body: A sea temple on the cliff edge. Go an hour before sunset for the Kecak fire dance.

items.title: Padang Padang Beach
items.body: A small cove reached through a gap in the rocks. Best in the morning before the crowds.

items.title: Melasti Beach
items.body: Wide white sand below dramatic cliffs, with easy parking.

items.title: Single Fin

items.title: Warung Local

property.summary: A sunlit loft in Prenzlauer Berg with a real desk and the U-Bahn at the door.
property.description:
A bright top-floor loft on Senefelderplatz in Prenzlauer Berg, with big windows on three sides and a view over the rooftops.

The open living space has a proper desk, a sofa that opens into a double bed and a kitchen with everything you need. The bedroom is tucked behind sliding doors.

The U2 stops right outside, so Mitte is ten minutes away.
property.additional_rules:
Well-behaved dogs are welcome; please let us know in advance.
The building is residential, so please keep it down on the stairs at night.
property.space: The loft takes up the whole top floor, with windows on three sides. A small lift goes up to the fourth floor; the last flight is a short staircase.
property.neighborhood: Senefelderplatz sits between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg: cafés, bakeries and the Saturday market on Kollwitzplatz are all a few minutes' walk away.
property.getting_around: The U2 stops at Senefelderplatz, right outside. Trams M1 and 12 are around the corner, and bikes are easy to rent.
property.cancellation_policy:
Full refund up to 5 days before check-in.
After that, the first night is non-refundable.

reviews.text: The light in this loft is incredible, and working from the desk by the window was a joy.
reviews.host_response: Danke, Daniel! Come back any time.

reviews.text: Perfect base for Berlin. Our dog loved the walks to Mauerpark, and so did we.
Lovely flat. The last flight of stairs is a bit tight with big suitcases, but worth it for the view.
reviews.host_response: Thanks for the tip! We now offer luggage drop-off downstairs.
